summary: Civil maintenance and repairs to the lighthouse tower, allied buildings and compound wall at Point Calimere Lighthouse under the Chennai Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Point Calimere Lighthouse
sites.work: Civil maintenance and repairs to lighthouse tower, allied buildings, compound wall

scope.item: Civil Maintenance & Repairs to Lighthouse Tower, allied buildings, Compound wall etc.

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Percentage rate contract. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai; validity stated as three months in the table and 90 days in clause 1.1. Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL etc or other State/Central Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80% of estimated cost; value updated at 7% p.a. simple; certificate from officer not below Executive Engineer
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Average annual financial turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 40% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2024
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), not-blacklisted affidavit, list of relatives in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: NIT dated 27/08/2024; Section I only, no BOQ. Bid download/submission 29.08.2024 10:00 to 18.09.2024 15:00; opening 19.09.2024 15:00. Page 5 is blank except the file number header.
